summary: This directory serves as the central domain hub for Gyomu-related business operations, consolidating data repositories, user management, milestone tracking, and calendar services to provide a unified interface for core application entities.
responsibilities: Manage CRUD operations for core domain entities
Orchestrate business-specific services for users and milestones
Provide access to market-specific calendar and holiday logic
Centralize configuration and lookup services for domain data
Expose unified interfaces for core business domain modules
relationships: The repository services provide the foundation for persisting and retrieving domain entities used by other modules.
Business services for users and milestones rely on repository operations to manage and validate core domain data.
Calendar and holiday services support business operations by providing temporal context for domain-specific activities.
designDecisions: Use of service-oriented architecture to encapsulate business logic
Centralized export strategy via index files for module consumption
Interface-driven design to allow for modularity and decoupling
Separation of domain entity management from operational utility services
